text:
maya: Heads-up — prepping a pricing/packaging decision for next quarter re: Private on-prem throughput & add-on caps. Need a quick sync.
liam: Customer request: wants per-tenant dedicated capacity + per-route throughput add-on. Asking for hard cap of 2TB egress/mo + SLA 99.9.
jun: Tech constraints: on-prem deployments can't autoscale burst across regions. Per-route QoS requires routing tokens and per-deploy config.
maya: Two main Qs: 1) Gate per-route throughput as an add-on or bundle into tiers? 2) Any legal/finance blockers for commit contracts & softcaps?
priya: Finance: bundling reduces upfront ARR; add-on increases MRR but complicates quoting. We need a minimum commit floor if we expose per-route as an add-on.
sam: @maya recommend we add a 'burst exceptions' clause. Legal won't accept unlimited burst. Draft suggestion: `burst windows capped at 72h; sustained overage billed at 150% list`.
liam: Customers asking for a softcap w/ credits instead of sharp cutoffs. Could model 3-tier burst (small/medium/large) + rollback path. :thinking_face:
jun: Implementation note: caching/batching reduce tokens but not network egress. On-prem egress is a per-site negotiation — we need to flag per-region contract limits.
maya: Proposed launch criteria: (a) TOS + billing policy for burst/overage, (b) finance-approved pricing sheets, (c) eng runbook for per-route throttling & observability, (d) 2 pilot customers signed for Private throughput SKU.
priya: Add finance ask: include revenue recognition impact and require 12mo minimum for Private + throughput add-on to qualify for preferred pricing.
sam: I'll draft a liability carveout + SLA tie to commit length. Also proposing 'priority routing' as a premium feature rather than included in base tier.
liam: I'll check with the two pilot customers — specifically softcap vs hard cap preference and what they'd pay for priority routing.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: branch `pkg/private-throughput` deployed to staging (docs + initial pricing matrix).
maya: Action items: @sam draft legal clause EOD, @jun run perf + egress feasibility tests by Tue, @priya model two pricing options (bundle vs add-on) and ROI by Tue EOD. Reconvene Wed 10:00am.
jun: On it. Quick heads-up: per-route QoS requires a config UI change and ~3 sprint dev effort (including tests).
liam: Noted. If pilots accept add-on, salesops will need SKUs + quoting template and an example SOW.
maya: Thanks team :thumbsup: closing thread.
